title: Nourishing Croatian Shrimp Salad
description: A citrusy, glassy-jelly salad that cures hangovers with redcurrants, binchotan charcoal, and keto-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a skillet over high heat and quickly sear shrimp in olive oil for 2 minutes per side until pink and cooked through, then set aside to cool.
In a small saucepan, combine coconut milk and agar-agar powder, whisk until smooth, then bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Reduce heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 2 minutes, then remove from heat and pour into a shallow dish to cool slightly.
While the agar mixture cools, zest one lime, juice the lime, and mix the juice, zest, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl.
Toss the cooled shrimp with the lime mixture, then add diced cucumber, sliced red onion, redcurrants, and chopped dill, stirring gently.
Once the agar mixture has thickened to a translucent gel consistency, fold it into the shrimp mixture, ensuring even coating.
Sprinkle the binchotan charcoal powder over the salad and stir to distribute the smoky flavor uniformly.
Cover the salad with plastic wrap, placing a small plate on top to keep it flat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set the gelatin.
Before serving, remove from the fridge, fluff gently with a fork, and garnish with additional dill if desired.
Serve chilled as a refreshing hangover cure or keto-friendly lunch option.
